sentences.en: There is a limit to how much one can tolerate.
sentences.zh: 一个人能容忍的程度是有限的。

sentences.en: I'm not going to tolerate this kind of behavior anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不会再忍受这种行为了。

sentences.en: There was nothing for it but to tolerate it.

senses.zh: 容许，允许（不同意或不喜欢的事物）；忍受，包容；（对药物、毒品或环境状况）有耐力，耐受；敷衍，应付
